messages:
alex-s: FYI FinEdge POC hit a hard stop — they returned the security questionnaire asking for VPC-only + HSM KMS. They also see intermittent slow first-token times on our hosted trial. Can eng + SE help triage?
maya-se: copying @dave and @infra-bot. Can you paste the slow request logs and the config they're using? Is this the large system prompt we demoed? :eyes:
dave: saw this earlier. Two things to confirm: 1) are they hitting 429 bursts? 2) what's their request shape (long system prompt vs many short ones)? Logs please.
carla: customer says sequence: auth -> first response ~1.2s then later spikes to 2.5-3s occasionally. They also saw a 429 once during a 30s demo when multiple seats tested concurrently.
alex-s: attaching excerpt from their client logs and our runtime trace below.
alex-s: ```
CLIENT: POST /v1/generate auth=redacted
body: {"model":"rwd-large-2026","input":"<very long system prompt> + user messages","max_tokens":512,"stream":true} 
RUNTIME: request_id=req_7a3f
RUNTIME_LOG: batch_size=1, batch_tokens=520, kv_cache_hit=false
RUNTIME_LOG: kv_cache_evict=27, kv_cache_ttl_ms=30000
RUNTIME_LOG: first_token_ms=1250, avg_token_ms=28
RUNTIME_LOG: 429 -> quota_burst_exhausted for customer_id=finedge
```
maya-se: thanks. Two quick hypotheses: (A) long system prompt forces batch_tokens>max_batch_tokens -> gets scheduled as single-item batch (batch_size=1) causing high TTFT, (B) KV cache TTL small -> frequent evictions on multi-turn causing rebuilds. Also the 429 looks like burst credits were used up during parallel demo.
dave: confirm. Runtime shows max_batch_tokens configured to 256 in global policy, but per-tenant override for FinEdge is 64 (old presales tweak). That mismatch + 520 token request => bypass batching. I'll check tenant policy.
dave: infra-bot, can you show recent policy changes for tenant=finedge?
infra-bot: policy-change: tenant=finedge updated batching.max_batch_tokens=64 at 2026-03-14T09:12:03Z by ops-automation
maya-se: action items from SE side: 1) ask FinEdge to trim system prompt or move large static context to prefix cache as KV entries, 2) run a small warmup with a 32-token request to populate caches, 3) request short concurrent load test so we can reproduce 429.
dave: eng actions: 1) temporarily bump tenant batching.max_batch_tokens -> 512 for FinEdge (can do a safe override), 2) increase kv_cache_ttl_ms -> 120000 for their tenant, 3) add a diagnostic flag to trace batch formation for their requests. I'll push an opt-in override. ETA 30m.
alex-s: finite question from FinEdge on pricing: if we suggest bumping to dedicated reserved capacity for their demo week, how do burst credits vs per-token pricing look? I told them we'd follow up.
maya-se: I'll draft a short quote: reserved week with 2x baseline throughput + temporary burst pool, fixed daily spend cap. Sales/Pricing will confirm.
carla: customer was worried about KMS/HSM — they need proof of KMS integration for our Private offering. Any docs we can share quickly?
dave: private deployment docs are in console -> security -> key management. I'll grab a link and a short runbook. Meanwhile, the hosted workaround (tenant overrides) should unblock the POC within a day.
alex-s: update: I applied the tenant override (batching.max_batch_tokens=512) and bumped kv_cache_ttl_ms to 120000 for finedge. Pinging FinEdge to rerun their demo.
dave: confirmed override applied on prod region-us-west-2, request tracing enabled for req_7a3f and subsequent IDs. Expect TTFT down to ~350-450ms for first token for similar 520-token requests if batching merges.
infra-bot: deploy-note: tenant override applied by infra-ops at 2026-03-14T10:05:12Z. No restart required.
carla: FinEdge reran and reports first token ~420ms and no 429s so far. They still want the KMS docs for contract.
alex-s: thanks team. I'll consolidate notes for the security questionnaire and pass to legal, and SE will follow up on pricing quote. :thumbsup:
dave: follow-up: we'll keep the tenant override for 72h then revert. If they move to Dedicated, we can bake defaults at commit time.
maya-se: tagging next steps: @carla prepare KMS runbook, @alex-s deliver pricing outline, @dave keep traces until 2026-03-17.
carla: on it.
alex-s: closing thread when legal confirms.
